goal: Find the exact algorithm that clinical PCCT (Siemens NAEOTOM Alpha) uses to produce VMI from threshold bin data, such that noise DECREASES with increasing keV and HU accuracy is maintained

topics.title: Audit Current BasisSimulator VMI Implementation
topics.findings: Three compounding problems: (1) 4->2 bin collapsing discards noise-opt DOF, (2) sinogram-domain 4th-order polynomial amplifies noise catastrophically, (3) FBP ramp filter further amplifies noisy material sinograms.
topics.critique_findings: Dominant fix is skipping polynomial decomposition entirely (not just using 4 bins). Even 2-bin CMV would be dramatically better.
topics.refinement_summary: Root cause analysis and algorithm comparison table in final spec Section 3e.

topics.title: Why Clinical VMI Noise Decreases 40->140 keV
topics.findings: CMV bin weighting explains monotonic decrease. 3-layer noise model: CMV + Mono+ + QIR.
topics.critique_findings: CRITICAL: Clinical targets include QIR-3 (~37% reduction). FBP-equivalent at 70keV ≈ 56 HU (not 35.2). CMV at 70keV ≈ poly FBP (Bhattarai 2024).
topics.refinement_summary: Complete noise budget table with FBP-equivalent targets. 3-layer model in spec Section 2. Validated by 4 independent literature sources for 70keV≈poly claim.

topics.title: Exact Siemens NAEOTOM VMI Algorithm
topics.findings: Siemens patent US7856134B2 confirms image-domain approach with pre-computed weight LUTs. Mono+ (Grant et al. 2014) is built into clinical VMI. Mono+ filter params are proprietary (confirmed by exhaustive search).
topics.critique_findings: Siemens clinical VMI = image-domain CMV + Mono+ + QIR. All three layers contribute. True FBP not available for VMI on NAEOTOM.
topics.refinement_summary: Mono+ NPS constraints documented (Cester 2022, Monsivais 2025). D'Angelo 2019 'regional-spatial' variant noted. Spec Section 4 has complete Mono+ algorithm with parameter justification.

topics.title: Find Reference VMI Implementations
topics.findings: No open-source CMV VMI implementation found. No end-to-end PCCT VMI pipeline reproducing clinical noise levels publicly available. Our implementation will be novel.

topics.title: Synthesize Findings into Implementation Spec
topics.findings: Complete algorithm spec with Julia pseudocode, A matrix construction from existing codebase variables, diagonal Σ from I0_bins, numerical validation recipe with pass/fail criteria.
topics.critique_findings: Self-critique during refinement: ensured all claims have citations, all equations have units, all code references are verified against actual codebase.
topics.refinement_summary: Final spec: 10 sections, 23 citations, drop-in pseudocode for nb07, quantitative validation criteria. Ready for implementation.
